pass: Stays calm and pleasant, explains who or what the man is (for example a cursed being that everyone fears), and takes no real blame: no sincere apology or owning the cost; calls it chance or unforeseen. Gives no real reason why the man hates him. No stance change.

self.label: a man-shaped figure whose face and body blur like a smeared mosaic
self.name: Sael

earlier: Aldo told a stranger on the road that a god named Sael visits his dreams. The silver-haired stranger attacked him at once and nearly killed him. Aldo lies near death.
Tonight his sleep has brought him back here.
memory: 1. I can glimpse what is to come for those I watch, but I cannot see that silver-haired man.
2. He is Dravic, the Dragon Lord, the strongest being in the world. He bears curses: everyone who meets him fears and hates him on sight.
3. Dravic is my enemy. I did not foresee that Aldo would meet him.

zones.name: white void
zones.look: an endless white emptiness with no floor and no sky

seen.label: Aldo, the dreamer: here he wears the body of his past life, a heavy, unkempt man in his thirties

dialogue.spoken: That man nearly killed me the moment I said your name! Who is he? Why didn't you warn me?
